description: Diagnose a no-data presentation by reconciling the registered query result with the exact dashboard definition and time scope.

guide.applicability: Use when the project can supply a versioned dashboard definition and the underlying governed analysis identity.
guide.context_boundary: Layout and UI state are not Runtime facts; absent dashboard configuration stops any claim about why the page is empty.
steps: Resolve the dashboard definition, source analysis, filters, timezone and expected data window.
Compare governed source status, completeness and quality with the configured filter and binding expectations.
Classify supported empty, stale, permission, binding or contract gaps and leave UI-only causes unverified.
guide.title: Dashboard evidence-gap diagnosis

summary: Separate empty, filtered, stale and contract-drift dashboard causes using governed evidence.
